name.en: Probe: traits on the character creation screen
name.ja: 計測: キャラ作成画面の特質

description.en: Records where the character creation screen keeps the traits and what the trait window is made of: the trait fields of StoryApp.character_vm before and after generate_trait / delete_trait / on_trait_generate_press / apply_trait_popup_display / apply_character_sheet / load_character_preset / generate_random_character, what TraitPopup receives and its widget tree, the TraitButton index, TraitVM.to_dict and create_trait. Read-only
description.ja: キャラ作成画面が特質をどこに持ち、特質の窓が何でできているかを録る。generate_trait / delete_trait / on_trait_generate_press / apply_trait_popup_display / apply_character_sheet / load_character_preset / generate_random_character の前後の StoryApp.character_vm の特質の欄、TraitPopup が受け取るものと部品の木、TraitButton の番号、TraitVM.to_dict、create_trait。読み取りだけでゲームは変えない

note.ja: 1プロセスあたり。部品の木の行は数えない
note.en: Per process. Widget tree lines are not counted
